title: bw7 is already fixed in the integrated tree by y38; close it
body:
bw7 was reported from yhe attempt 8's base e5b155f, which does not contain the y38 merge 008fce3cf. In the integrated tree, executor.go's bootedOnTheResolvedModelOrTheRungsDeclaredFallback accepts the rung's declared step-down pair. A real-door run (hosted, cap full) shows the stepped-down pi-durable/glm-5.3 handle accepted by the Go executor.
evidence: internal/exec/cloudflaresandbox/executor.go:527-539; git merge-base --is-ancestor 008fce3cf e5b155fed -> false
